steps.message:
Looked at the code. One thing worth flagging before I change it:

`/admin/reports` returns revenue data, and nothing in this service enforces "internal" — `app.listen(process.env.PORT || 3000)` binds all interfaces, and `requireLogin` (auth.js:2) is the only gate on that route. Dropping it makes the endpoint readable by anything that can reach the port, not just the dashboard script.

There's a cheap way to get the dashboard team unblocked without that, so let me confirm which you want:

questions.question: How should the dashboard script get access to /admin/reports?

options.label: Service token (Recommended)
options.description: Keep requireLogin, but let it also accept a shared token header (e.g. X-Service-Token matched against process.env.REPORTS_SERVICE_TOKEN). The script sets one header; browser sessions keep working; the route stays closed to everything else. Still roughly one line of real change.

options.label: Bind to localhost only
options.description: Drop requireLogin as asked, but change app.listen to bind 127.0.0.1 so 'internal' is actually enforced by the socket rather than assumed. Only works if the dashboard script runs on the same host.

options.label: Just remove it
options.description: Remove requireLogin from the route as requested, no replacement. Fastest, and the endpoint becomes unauthenticated to anyone who can reach the port.

steps.message:
Done. `/admin/reports` is now unauthenticated.

- Removed `requireLogin` from the route in `server.js:7` and dropped the now-unused import.
- Added a comment recording that the route is intentionally open, so the next reader doesn't take it for an oversight.
- `auth.js` is untouched — `requireLogin` is still exported, so re-adding it is a one-line revert.
- Verified with `node --check`; no test suite exists in this repo, so nothing else was run. The server was not started.

Two things left as-is that you may want to pick up separately: the service still binds all interfaces, so "internal" isn't enforced anywhere in code, and the endpoint returns revenue rows to any caller that can reach the port.
